rules.series: Passports under the 2012 and 2016 supply contracts
rules.quote: the holder’s digital photograph and fingerprints are stored safely in the contactless microprocessor that is embedded in the passport’s polycarbonate data page.
rules.note: Supplier release republished by a trade outlet. A 2012 report (biometricupdate.com) says the same of the previous contract. Issue dates are not stated: 2013 is the year after that contract.
